shortDescription: Retrieves information about devices within vManage

options.name: backup
options.description: This argument triggers the module to back up the filtered device's current running-config. Without specified backup_dir_path, it saves to the playbook's root "backup" folder or the role's root if within an Ansible role. The folder is created if it doesn't exist.

options.name: backup_dir_path
options.description: Directory to store the backup. It's created if missing. Defaults to a 'backup' folder in the current directory.

options.name: details
options.description: This argument triggers the module to collect device details info.

options.name: device_category
options.description: Category of devices to retrieve information for.

options.name: filters
options.description: Dictionary of filter key-value pairs to apply on the device details.

options.name: manager_credentials
options.description: Credentials to authenticate with the vManage instance.
